prompt: 'It works on my machine,' he says, but it fails on the server.
why: Different setups cause different behaviour. That's an environment difference.
trap: Reproducing is hard because the environments differ.

prompt: Her laptop runs Node 20 and the server runs Node 16.
tells: Node 20 and the server runs Node 16
why: Different versions behave differently. Environment difference.
trap: Nothing changed recently; they were always different.

prompt: The secret key is set on his laptop but missing in production.
why: Settings that differ between places cause bugs.
trap: It isn't user data; it's the setup.

prompt: File paths with backslashes break on the Linux server.
trap: The path isn't bad data; the system differs.

prompt: Tests pass in London and fail on the build server set to UTC-8.
tells: the build server set to UTC-8
why: Timezone is part of the environment.
trap: Dates can be off by one, but the cause is the setting.

prompt: The team runs the app in the same container everywhere so setups match.
why: Matching environments prevents this kind of bug.
trap: It helps reproduce, but the aim is same setup.
